```{r}
county_shp <- st_read("C:/Users/p739b253/Documents/USA_Counties/USA_Counties.shp")

colnames(county_data) <- c("county", "FIPS", "R2" ,"slope", "I", "Qred", "pumping", "chng", "Qav", "precip")
county_shp$FIPS <- as.numeric((county_shp$FIPS)) 
shp_with_data <- left_join(county_shp, county_data, by="FIPS")
shp_CARB <- subset(shp_with_data, is.finite(slope))
ggplot(shp_CARB, aes(fill = slope, color = STATE_NAME))+geom_sf()

#Orginal plot
ggplot(shp_CARB, aes(fill = slope, color = STATE_NAME))+geom_sf()

```

#Histogram fo key parameters
```{r}
x_expression <- expression(R^2)
#title <- Histogram
a<- ggplot(county_data, aes(x = r2)) +       # Modify color around bars
  geom_histogram(col = "black", binwidth = 0.12, fill="white")+
  labs(x=x_expression, y="Frequency", title="Histogram", size=8)+
   #(color = "red", size = 1)+
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(r2, na.rm=T)), 
               color="darkgray", linetype="dashed", size=1)+
  theme_classic()
a<- a + theme(text = element_text(size = 18))  
a

x_expression <- expression(Slope)
#title <- Histogram~of~Slope
b<- ggplot(county_data, aes(x = slope)) +       # Modify color around bars
  geom_histogram(col = "black", binwidth = 4, fill="white")+
  labs(x=x_expression, y="Frequency")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(slope, na.rm=T)), 
               color="darkgray", linetype="dashed", size=1)+
  theme_classic() 
b<- b + theme(text = element_text(size = 18))
b


x_expression <- expression(Qstable ~ (10^6~ m^3))
#title <- Histogram~of~Qstable
c<- ggplot(county_data, aes(x = Qstable)) +     # Modify color around bars
  geom_histogram(col = "black", binwidth = 0.055, fill="white")+
  labs(x=x_expression, y="Frequency")+
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(Qstable, na.rm=T)), 
               color="darkgray", linetype="dashed", size=1)+
  theme_classic() 
c<- c + theme(text = element_text(size = 18))  
c


hist<- a|b|c
hist
```

